instruction: Using only the standalone learner-facing English stem, prompts, and opaque token pools, select exactly one condition, two actions, and two parameters. Return the required structured JSON, including exactly one premise row for every opaque token. Do not infer absent client-specific facts.
stem: An adult with a rapidly enlarging pericardial effusion becomes restless and cool. Blood pressure is 78/50 mm Hg, heart rate is 128/min, and jugular venous pressure is elevated. Echocardiography shows right-atrial and right-ventricular diastolic collapse. The client has a pulse, breath sounds are equal, and an experienced drainage team is available. Complete the bow-tie by choosing the condition, 2 actions, and 2 parameters to monitor.

actions.label: A1
actions.text: Begin routine positive-pressure ventilation before drainage

actions.label: A2
actions.text: Activate immediate image-guided pericardial drainage by the qualified team

actions.label: A3
actions.text: Provide prescribed cautious temporary IV fluid support while urgent drainage is readied

actions.label: A4
actions.text: Administer an ordered IV diuretic to lower preload

parameters.label: P1
parameters.text: Echocardiographic chamber collapse, residual effusion, and pericardial drain output

parameters.label: P2
parameters.text: Tracheal position and unilateral breath sounds

parameters.label: P3
parameters.text: Blood pressure, heart rate, pulsus findings, and peripheral perfusion
